title: Broncos LB Jonathon Cooper pleads not guilty to domestic violence charges

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Broncos' Cooper pleads not guilty; trial date set
sources.description: Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper pleaded not guilty Monday morning in a Douglas County (Colorado) courtroom to misdemeanor domestic violence charges.
